name: Roux Quinley
source:
Occupation: Informant
Age: Unknown
Height: 6'
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Star Sign: Libra
Characteristics: Trickster, sweet, playful, enthusiastic
Affiliation: The Fae Folk

Roux is... Roux. They are the watchful eye that follows you in the forests that surround the kingdom, and they are the friendly face that greets you with a smile in the tavern. They know everything, and they will eagerly offer you assistance in your time of need. However, don't think them a friend too fast, because Roux is also mischievous, and nothing is ever what it seems...
